帮忙.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng máng
帮忙.en: I look to you for help.

帮忙.zh: 现在只看他们会不会帮忙了。
帮忙.pinyin: Xiàn zài zhǐ kàn tā men huì bù huì bāng máng le
帮忙.en: It all depends on whether they will support us.
帮忙.es: Todo depende de si nos van a apoyar.

帮忙.es: Necesito un poco de ayuda tuya.

帮忙.zh: 如果你发现有错的话请帮忙改正。

帮忙.es: Si ves un error, entonces corrígelo, por favor.

或者.en: He was always annoyed in the city by noises of one sort or another.

或者.zh: 我或者去看电影，或者去看歌剧。
或者.pinyin: Wǒ huò zhě qù kàn diàn yǐng huò zhě qù kàn gē jù
或者.en: I am either going to see a film, or going to see an opera.

饮料.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē diǎn rè de yǐn liào
饮料.en: I want something hot to drink.

饮料.zh: 你最喜欢的饮料是什么？

饮料.zh: 这种饮料是免费招待的。

饮料.zh: 食物和饮料是物质需求。

熊猫.zh: 上星期天我的家庭去了动物园看熊猫。
熊猫.pinyin: Shàng xīng qī tiān wǒ de jiā tíng qù le dòng wù yuán kàn xióng māo
熊猫.en: My family went to the zoo to see pandas last Sunday.
熊猫.es: El domingo pasado mi familia fue al zoológico a ver pandas.

熊猫.es: El oso panda es el tesoro nacional de China.

无.pinyin: Shuǐ zhì qīng zé wú yú

无.en: Where there is grass, there is no water. Where there is water, there is no grass.

无.pinyin: Zài kōng wú yī wù de dì fang huáng dì zài dà de quán lì yě wú yòng
无.en: In an empty place, an emperor has no power.

无.zh: 人是生而自由的，但却无往不在枷锁之中。
无.pinyin: Rén shì shēng ér zì yóu de dàn què wú wǎng bù zài jiā suǒ zhī zhōng

仔细.zh: 你可以仔细检查一下我的报告吗?

仔细.en: I tried to listen to him carefully.

仔细.zh: 仔细的比较一下，就会发现两者之间的分别了。
仔细.pinyin: Zǐ xì de bǐ jiào yī xià jiù huì fā xiàn liǎng zhě zhī jiān de fēn bié le
仔细.en: Compare the two carefully, and you will see the difference.
仔细.es: Compara ambos atentamente y verás la diferencia.

仔细.zh: 援救人员为了找到孩子，仔细搜索了那个区域。
仔细.pinyin: Yuán jiù rén yuán wèi le zhǎo dào hái zi zǐ xì sōu suǒ le nà ge qū yù
仔细.en: The rescuers searched the surroundings in hopes of finding the child.

蝴蝶.zh: 我抓到一只漂亮的蝴蝶。

酒吧.zh: 我跟我朋友常常去酒吧。

酒吧.en: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.
酒吧.es: A una amiga mía le encanta ir a los bares gays conmigo.

酒吧.zh: 不管你有没有通过中文考试，我们一起去酒吧喝啤酒。
酒吧.pinyin: Bù guǎn nǐ yǒu méi yǒu tōng guò zhōng wén kǎo shì wǒ men yī qǐ qù jiǔ bā hē pí jiǔ
酒吧.en: Whether you pass the Chinese exam or not, let's go to the bar to drink beer.
酒吧.es: Apruebes o no el examen de chino, vamos al pub a tomar una cerveza.

酒吧.zh: 你五点钟还没睡觉！刚从酒吧回来了，是不是？

酒吧.en: It's five and you're still not in bed! You just came back from the bar, didn't you?
酒吧.es: Son las cinco y todavía no estás en la cama. Acabas de llegar del bar, ¿verdad?

除非.zh: 除非是你做饭，否则我是不会吃的。
除非.pinyin: Chú fēi shì nǐ zuò fàn fǒu zé wǒ shì bù huì chī de
除非.en: I won't eat it unless you cooked it.
除非.es: No lo voy a comer a menos que lo hayas preparado tú.

除非.zh: 除非我问你，请你不要说话。
除非.pinyin: Chú fēi wǒ wèn nǐ qǐng nǐ bù yào shuō huà
除非.es: No digas nada a no ser que te pregunte.

除非.zh: 除非有人跟他说话，他不说话。
除非.pinyin: Chú fēi yǒu rén gēn tā shuō huà tā bù shuō huà
除非.en: He did not speak unless spoken to.
除非.es: Él no hablaba a menos que le hablaran.

蜜蜂.pinyin: Wǒ bèi mì fēng zhē le yī xià

蜜蜂.zh: 蜜蜂的嗡嗡让我有一点紧张。

蜜蜂.en: The buzzing of the bees makes me a little nervous.
蜜蜂.es: El zumbido de las abejas me pone un poco nerviosa.

蜜蜂.zh: 我们被一大群蜜蜂攻击。
蜜蜂.pinyin: Wǒ men bèi yī dà qún mì fēng gōng jī
蜜蜂.en: We were attacked by swarms of bees.
蜜蜂.es: Fuimos atacados por enjambres de abejas.

蜜蜂.zh: 蜜蜂螫人可以是非常痛苦的。
蜜蜂.pinyin: Mì fēng shì rén kě yǐ shì fēi cháng tòng kǔ de
蜜蜂.en: Bee stings can be very painful.
蜜蜂.es: Las picaduras de abeja pueden ser muy dolorosas.

状况.zh: 汤姆应该用别的方式处理这状况。

状况.en: Tom should have handled the situation differently.
状况.es: Tom debió haber manejado la situación de otra forma.

状况.zh: 他详细地描述了事故状况。
状况.pinyin: Tā xiáng xì de miáo shù liǎo shì gù zhuàng kuàng
状况.en: He described the incident in detail.

状况.zh: 能告诉我你的婚姻状况吗？
状况.pinyin: Néng gào su wǒ nǐ de hūn yīn zhuàng kuàng ma
状况.en: Can you tell me about your marital status?

状况.zh: 我父亲的状况时好时坏。
状况.pinyin: Wǒ fù qīn de zhuàng kuàng shí hǎo shí huài
状况.en: My father's condition seems to improve one moment, but the next moment he sinks again.

集中.zh: 他们太吵了，我没办法集中精神了。
集中.pinyin: Tā men tài chǎo le wǒ méi bàn fǎ jí zhōng jīng shén le
集中.en: They're too noisy; I can't concentrate.
集中.es: Son demasiado ruidosos, no puedo concentrarme.

集中.zh: 在拿笔之前，我要集中一下思想。
集中.pinyin: Zài ná bǐ zhī qián wǒ yào jí zhōng yī xià sī xiǎng
集中.en: I must put my ideas together before I take up a pen.
集中.es: Tengo que ordenar mis ideas antes de agarrar el lápiz.

集中.zh: 这些点都是病毒集中的地方。
集中.pinyin: Zhè xiē diǎn dōu shì bìng dú jí zhōng de dì fang
集中.en: All those dots are viral focuses.
集中.es: Todos esos puntos son focos virales.

集中.zh: 他试图把注意力集中在信上。
集中.pinyin: Tā shì tú bǎ zhù yì lì jí zhōng zài xìn shàng
集中.en: He tried to concentrate on the letter.
集中.es: Él trató de concentrarse en la carta.

占.zh: 对不起，这位子是否被人家占了？
占.pinyin: Duì bu qǐ zhè wèi zi shì fǒu bèi rén jiā zhàn le
占.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?

占.pinyin: Chuáng zhàn le hěn duō kōng jiān
占.en: The bed took up a lot of space.

占.zh: 这张沙发占了太多空间。
占.pinyin: Zhè zhāng shā fā zhàn le tài duō kōng jiān
占.en: This sofa takes up too much space.

占.pinyin: Zhè tái jī qì hěn zhàn kōng jiān
占.en: The machine takes a lot of room.

风险.zh: 我不想承担这样一个风险。
风险.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng chéng dān zhè yàng yī ge fēng xiǎn
风险.en: I don't want to take such a risk.
风险.es: No quiero tomar un riesgo así.

风险.zh: 我知道你冒了多大的风险。
风险.pinyin: Wǒ zhī dào nǐ mào le duō dà de fēng xiǎn
Wǒ bù dān xīn fēng xiǎn
风险.en: I don't worry about the risk.

灰尘.zh: 我用吸尘机把地上的灰尘吸掉了。
灰尘.pinyin: Wǒ yòng xī chén jī bǎ dì shang de huī chén xī diào le
灰尘.en: I sucked up the dust on the floor with a vacuum cleaner.
灰尘.es: Aspiré el polvo del suelo con una aspiradora.

灰尘.zh: 杰克刷去了他外套上的灰尘。
灰尘.pinyin: Jié kè shuā qù le tā wài tào shàng de huī chén
灰尘.en: Jack brushed the dust off his coat.
灰尘.es: Jack se sacudió el polvo de su abrigo.

灰尘.zh: 所有的家具都布满了灰尘。
灰尘.pinyin: Suǒ yǒu de jiā jù dōu bù mǎn le huī chén
灰尘.en: All the furniture was covered with dust.
灰尘.es: Todos los muebles estaban llenos de polvo.

灰尘.zh: 把架子上的灰尘擦一下。
灰尘.pinyin: Bǎ jià zi shàng de huī chén cā yī xià
灰尘.en: Clean the dust off the shelf.
灰尘.es: Límpiale el polvo a la repisa.

的确.zh: 虽然听起来很奇怪，但是她说的的确是真的。
的确.pinyin: Suī rán tīng qi lai hěn qí guài dàn shì tā shuō de dí què shì zhēn de
的确.en: Even though it sounds strange, what she said is true.
的确.es: Por más extraño que suene, lo que ella dijo es verdad.

的确.pinyin: Tā dí què shì zhèng què de

的确.zh: 我不知道他来这里的确切时间。
的确.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào tā lái zhè lǐ dí què qiē shí jiān
的确.en: I don't know for certain when he will come.

的确.zh: 我抓不到句子的确切含义。
的确.pinyin: Wǒ zhuā bù dào jù zi dí què qiē hán yì
的确.en: I can't get at the exact meaning of the sentence.

合同.zh: 我和这家公司签了三年合同。
合同.pinyin: Wǒ hé zhè jiā gōng sī qiān le sān nián hé tong
合同.en: This company and I have signed a contract of three years.
合同.es: Esta compañía y yo firmamos un contrato a tres años.

合同.zh: 你在签字前必须仔细看合同。
合同.pinyin: Nǐ zài qiān zì qián bì xū zǐ xì kàn hé tong
合同.en: You must look over the contract before you sign it.
合同.es: Usted debe revisar cuidadosamente el contrato antes de firmarlo.

合同.zh: 我跟公司签了一份三年的合同。
合同.pinyin: Wǒ gēn gōng sī qiān le yī fèn sān nián de hé tong
合同.en: This company and I have signed a three-year contract.

合同.zh: 他们的合同在这个月底到期。
合同.pinyin: Tā men de hé tong zài zhè ge yuè dǐ dào qī
合同.en: Their contract is to run out at the end of this month.

戒指.zh: 我们之间完了，把戒指还给我！
戒指.pinyin: Wǒ men zhī jiān wán le bǎ jiè zhi huán gěi wǒ
戒指.en: It's over between us. Give me back my ring!

戒指.zh: 他半夜给了我一枚戒指。
戒指.pinyin: Tā bàn yè gěi le wǒ yī méi jiè zhi
戒指.en: He gave me a ring at midnight.

戒指.pinyin: Tā men dài zhe áng guì de jiè zhi

戒指.zh: 我觉得这钻石戒指太奢侈了。
戒指.pinyin: Wǒ jué de zhè zuàn shí jiè zhi tài shē chǐ le
戒指.en: This diamond ring is too extravagant for me.
戒指.es: Este anillo de diamante es muy extravagante para mí.

问候.pinyin: Dài wǒ wèn hòu nǐ mā mā
问候.en: Say hello to your mum for me.
问候.es: Saluda a tu mamá de mi parte.

问候.pinyin: Dài wǒ wèn hòu nǐ mèi mei
问候.en: Say hello to your sister for me.
问候.es: Saluda a tu hermana de mi parte.

问候.zh: 我遇见了以前的班主任时，他问候了我的父母。
问候.pinyin: Wǒ yù jiàn le yǐ qián de bān zhǔ rèn shí tā wèn hòu le wǒ de fù mǔ
问候.en: When I met my former teacher, he inquired after my parents.

因素.zh: 将要考虑的另一个重要因素是，目前的情况对我们有利。
因素.pinyin: Jiāng yào kǎo lǜ de lìng yī gè zhòng yào yīn sù shì mù qián de qíng kuàng duì wǒ men yǒu lì
因素.en: Another factor to be taken into consideration is that the present situation is favourable to us.
因素.es: Otro factor a tener en cuenta es que la presente situación nos es favorable.

因素.zh: 诚实是他成功最重要的因素。
因素.pinyin: Chéng shí shì tā chéng gōng zuì zhòng yào de yīn sù
因素.en: Honesty was the most important factor in his success.
因素.es: La honestidad fue el factor más importante en su éxito.

因素.zh: 酗酒是导致阳痿的一个因素。
因素.pinyin: Xù jiǔ shì dǎo zhì yáng wěi de yī ge yīn sù
因素.en: Excessive drinking is one of the causes of impotence.
因素.es: El exceso de bebida es una de las causas de impotencia.

因素.zh: 由于诸多不幸因素，单亲家庭的数量在增长中。
因素.pinyin: Yóu yú zhū duō bù xìng yīn sù dān qīn jiā tíng de shù liàng zài zēng zhǎng zhōng
因素.en: Due to a number of unfortunate causes, one-parent families are on the increase.
因素.es: Debido a ciertas causas desventajosas, existe un aumento de familias donde solo existe un padre.

乐器.zh: 我最喜欢的乐器是电吉他。
乐器.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐ huan de yuè qì shì diàn jí tā
乐器.en: My favourite musical instrument is the electric guitar.
乐器.es: Mi instrumento musical favorito es la guitarra eléctrica.

乐器.pinyin: Dàn huáng jiàng shì yī zhǒng yuè qì ma
Nǐ yǎn zòu yuè qì ma
乐器.en: Do you play a musical instrument?

乐器.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？
乐器.pinyin: Chú le gāng qín yǐ wài hái huì wán shén me yuè qì ma
乐器.en: Do you play any other instruments besides the piano?
乐器.es: Además del piano, ¿sabes tocar otros instrumentos?

修改.zh: 我正在寻找可以帮我修改这篇论文的母语人士。
修改.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng zài xún zhǎo kě yǐ bāng wǒ xiū gǎi zhè piān lùn wén de mǔ yǔ rén shì
修改.en: I am looking for a native speaker who can correct this paper for me.
修改.es: Estoy buscando a un hablante nativo que me pueda ayudar a corregir este ensayo.

修改.pinyin: Xiè xie nǐ de xiū gǎi

修改.zh: 我们想修改学校的规章制度。
修改.pinyin: Wǒ men xiǎng xiū gǎi xué xiào de guī zhāng zhì dù
修改.en: We want to modify the regulations of our school.

修改.zh: 在得到确认之前不要进行任何修改。
修改.pinyin: Zài dé dào què rèn zhī qián bù yào jìn xíng rèn hé xiū gǎi
修改.en: Do not make any modifications before you get confirmations.

阶段.zh: 工程的第一阶段已经完成了。
阶段.pinyin: Gōng chéng de dì yī jiē duàn yǐ jīng wán chéng le
阶段.en: The first phase of construction has been completed.
阶段.es: Se ha completado la primera fase de la construcción.

阶段.zh: 癌症如果在第一阶段被发现的话是很容易治愈的。
阶段.pinyin: Ái zhèng rú guǒ zài dì yī jiē duàn bèi fā xiàn de huà shì hěn róng yì zhì yù de
阶段.en: Cancer can be cured easily if it is found in its first phase.
阶段.es: El cáncer puede ser curado con facilidad si es diagnosticado en la primera fase.

阶段.zh: 您可以跳过认证过程的第三阶段，直接进入第六阶段。
阶段.pinyin: Nín kě yǐ tiào guò rèn zhèng guò chéng de dì sān jiē duàn zhí jiē jìn rù dì liù jiē duàn
阶段.en: You can skip stage three of the certification process and advance immediately to stage six.

阶段.zh: 空间科学还在起步阶段。
阶段.pinyin: Kōng jiān kē xué hái zài qǐ bù jiē duàn
阶段.en: Space science is still in its infancy.

临时.zh: 家豪说他今天不来了，临时加班。
临时.pinyin: Jiā háo shuō tā jīn tiān bù lái le lín shí jiā bān
临时.en: Jia-hao said he's not coming today. He has a last-minute overtime.

临时.zh: 事先打个招呼，别叫我临时抓瞎。
临时.pinyin: Shì xiān dá gè zhāo hu bié jiào wǒ lín shí zhuā xiā
临时.en: Let me know beforehand instead of springing it on me at the last minute.

告别.pinyin: Tā xiàng xué sheng men gào bié le
告别.en: He bade farewell to the students.

告别.zh: 唐纳德彻底告别了那种虚假的生活。
告别.pinyin: Táng nà dé chè dǐ gào bié le nà zhǒng xū jiǎ de shēng huó
告别.en: Donald said goodbye to that fake life forever.

善于.pinyin: Tā hěn shàn yú kǎn jià
善于.en: She's good at bargaining the price down.

善于.zh: 他善于在青年中识拔人才。
善于.pinyin: Tā shàn yú zài qīng nián zhōng shí bá rén cái
善于.en: He is good at spotting young talent.

形势.zh: 形势似乎非常紧张严峻。
形势.pinyin: Xíng shì sì hū fēi cháng jǐn zhāng yán jùn
形势.en: The situation seemed very tense and dangerous.
形势.es: La situación parecía muy tensa y peligrosa.

形势.zh: 两相比较，他那边的形势更不利一些。
形势.pinyin: Liǎng xiāng bǐ jiào tā nà bian de xíng shì gèng bù lì yī xiē
形势.en: The comparison between the two was to his disadvantage.

形势.zh: 文章开头讲了当前的形势。
形势.pinyin: Wén zhāng kāi tóu jiǎng liǎo dàng qián de xíng shì
形势.en: The article begins with an account of the current situation.

形势.zh: 最近这个区域的国际形势很紧张。
形势.pinyin: Zuì jìn zhè ge qū yù de guó jì xíng shì hěn jǐn zhāng
形势.en: Recently, this area's international relations have become very tense.

搜索.zh: 你们可以搜索含有某个词的句子并得到这些句子的翻译。
搜索.pinyin: Nǐ men kě yǐ sōu suǒ hán yǒu mǒu gè cí de jù zi bìng dé dào zhè xiē jù zi de fān yì
搜索.en: You can search sentences containing a certain word and get translations for these sentences.
搜索.es: Puedes buscar oraciones que contengan una palabra determinada y obtener traducciones para estas oraciones.

搜索.zh: 援救人员为了找到孩子，仔细搜索了那个区域。
搜索.pinyin: Yuán jiù rén yuán wèi le zhǎo dào hái zi zǐ xì sōu suǒ le nà ge qū yù
搜索.en: The rescuers searched the surroundings in hopes of finding the child.
搜索.es: El rescatista recorrió el área en búsqueda del niño.

搜索.zh: 我们分散开来并在树林中展开搜索。
搜索.pinyin: Wǒ men fēn sàn kāi lái bìng zài shù lín zhōng zhǎn kāi sōu suǒ
搜索.en: We spread out and began to search through the woods.

分配.zh: 现在不止要男女薪金平等，而且还要平均分配家务。
分配.pinyin: Xiàn zài bù zhǐ yào nán nǚ xīn jīn píng děng ér qiě hái yào píng jūn fēn pèi jiā wù
分配.en: It is time not only to equalize men's and women's wages, but also to equalize responsibility for housework.

本人.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào tā shì rì běn rén
本人.en: I didn't know that he was Japanese.

本人.zh: 他们不知道我是日本人。
本人.pinyin: Tā men bù zhī dào wǒ shì rì běn rén
本人.en: They don't know that I'm Japanese.
本人.es: Ellos no saben que soy japonés.

本人.pinyin: Tā men shì rì běn rén ma
Wǒ shì rì běn rén xiǎo nán hái dā dào

把手.zh: 我叫你的名字的时候，请你把手举起来。
把手.pinyin: Wǒ jiào nǐ de míng zi de shí hou qǐng nǐ bǎ shǒu jǔ qǐ lái
把手.en: Raise your hand when I call your name.
把手.es: Levanta la mano cuando llamo tu nombre.

把手.zh: 我不弯膝也能把手掌平放在地上。
把手.pinyin: Wǒ bù wān xī yě néng bǎ shǒu zhǎng píng fàng zài dì shàng
把手.en: I can place the palms of my hands on the floor without bending my knees.
把手.es: Puedo poner las palmas de mis manos sobre el piso sin doblar las rodillas.

把手.pinyin: Bǎ shǒu jǔ qǐ lái zhè shì qiǎng jié
把手.en: Hands up! This is a robbery.
把手.es: ¡Arriba las manos! Esto es un atraco.

把手.pinyin: Tā bǎ shǒu chā jìn kǒu dài lǐ
把手.en: He put his hands in his pockets.
把手.es: Él se metió las manos en los bolsillos.

奴隶.pinyin: Bù yào chéng wéi jīn qián de nú lì
奴隶.en: Don't be a slave to money.

奴隶.zh: 我拒绝被你像奴隶一样对待。
奴隶.pinyin: Wǒ jù jué bèi nǐ xiàng nú lì yī yàng duì dài
奴隶.en: I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.
奴隶.es: Me niego a que me trates como un esclavo.

奴隶.zh: 人有选择的权利，但是奴隶却只有服从的份儿。
奴隶.pinyin: Rén yǒu xuǎn zé de quán lì dàn shì nú lì què zhǐ yǒu fú cóng de fènr
奴隶.en: A man chooses; a slave obeys.
奴隶.es: Un hombre elige; un esclavo obedece.

奴隶.zh: 汤姆把玛丽当成自己的奴隶一样看待。
奴隶.pinyin: Tāng mǔ bǎ mǎ lì dàng chéng zì jǐ de nú lì yī yàng kàn dài
奴隶.en: Tom treated Mary like a slave.
奴隶.es: Tom trataba a Mary como a una esclava.

新娘.pinyin: Xīn niáng kàn qǐ lai fēi cháng piào liang
新娘.es: La novia se veía muy bella.

新娘.zh: 新郎现在在一家公司工作，新娘是我们的老师。
新娘.pinyin: Xīn láng xiàn zài zài yī jiā gōng sī gōng zuò xīn niáng shì wǒ men de lǎo shī
新娘.en: The groom works for a company now, and the bride is our teacher.

新娘.zh: 发给好朋友的请帖上有新郎新娘合影的照片。
新娘.pinyin: Fā gěi hǎo péng you de qǐng tiě shàng yǒu xīn láng xīn niáng hé yǐng de zhào piàn
新娘.en: There's a photo of the bride and groom together on the invitation sent to friends.

策略.zh: 诚实不总是最好的策略。
策略.pinyin: Chéng shí bù zǒng shì zuì hǎo de cè lüè
策略.en: Honesty is not always the best policy.
策略.es: La honestidad no es siempre la mejor política.

策略.zh: 他们到位了实行新概念的广告策略。
策略.pinyin: Tā men dào wèi le shí xíng xīn gài niàn de guǎng gào cè lüè
策略.en: They implemented a communication policy so as to promote their new concept.

策略.pinyin: Xī wàng bù shì yī zhǒng cè lüè

版本.pinyin: Wǒ gèng piān xiàng yú zhè ge bǎn běn

版本.zh: 第一还是第二的版本比较齐全？
版本.pinyin: Dì yī hái shi dì èr de bǎn běn bǐ jiào qí quán
版本.en: Which is more complete, the first edition or the second?
版本.es: ¿Cuál es más completa, la primera edición o la segunda?

版本.zh: 分支和合并是版本控制的两种基本操作。
版本.pinyin: Fēn zhī hé hé bìng shì bǎn běn kòng zhì de liǎng zhǒng jī běn cāo zuò
版本.en: Branching and merging are two basic operations of revision control.
版本.es: Ramificación e integración son dos acciones básicas del control de versiones.

版本.zh: 你有听过那首歌的法文版本吗？
版本.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu tīng guo nà shǒu gē de fǎ wén bǎn běn ma
版本.en: Have you ever heard that song sung in French?

目睹.zh: 所目睹的不一定是真的。
目睹.pinyin: Suǒ mù dǔ de bù yī dìng shì zhēn de
目睹.en: Things that you see with your eyes are not necessarily true.
目睹.es: No todo lo que ven nuestros ojos es necesariamente cierto.

目睹.zh: 我不忍目睹这种残酷的行径。
目睹.pinyin: Wǒ bù rěn mù dǔ zhè zhǒng cán kù de xíng jìng
目睹.en: I cannot abide to see such cruelty.

目睹.zh: 说起交通事故，我去年目睹了一场。
目睹.pinyin: Shuō qǐ jiāo tōng shì gù wǒ qù nián mù dǔ le yī chǎng
目睹.en: Speaking of traffic accidents, I saw one last year.
目睹.es: Hablando de accidentes de tráfico: vi uno el año pasado.

目睹.pinyin: Tā mù dǔ le móu shā àn

坦白.zh: “坦白说，我有恐高症。”“你是个胆小鬼！”
坦白.pinyin: Tǎn bái shuō wǒ yǒu kǒng gāo zhèng nǐ shì gè dǎn xiǎo guǐ
坦白.en: "To tell you the truth, I am scared of heights." "You are a coward!"
坦白.es: "A decir verdad, tengo vértigo." "¡Eres un cobarde!"

坦白.zh: 我该不该跟她坦白我的过去？
坦白.pinyin: Wǒ gāi bù gāi gēn tā tǎn bái wǒ de guò qù
坦白.en: Should I make a confession of my past to her?

坦白.zh: 坦白地说，我不喜欢你的发型。
坦白.pinyin: Tǎn bái de shuō wǒ bù xǐ huan nǐ de fà xíng
坦白.en: Frankly speaking, I don't like your haircut.

财政.zh: 俄罗斯面临着严重的财政困难。
财政.pinyin: É luó sī miàn lín zhe yán zhòng de cái zhèng kùn nan
财政.en: Russia is facing great financial difficulties.
财政.es: Rusia está enfrentando una gran dificultad financiera.

财政.zh: 我们必须从财政方面考虑一下这个计划。
财政.pinyin: Wǒ men bì xū cóng cái zhèng fāng miàn kǎo lǜ yī xià zhè ge jì huà
财政.en: We must consider the financial aspects of this project.

财政.zh: 减税常被用作刺激经济的主要财政手段。
财政.pinyin: Jiǎn shuì cháng bèi yòng zuò cì jī jīng jì de zhǔ yào cái zhèng shǒu duàn
财政.en: Tax cuts are often used as a major fiscal tool to stimulate the economy.

倾向.zh: 在我看来，她有一种夸张的倾向。
倾向.pinyin: Zài wǒ kàn lái tā yǒu yī zhǒng kuā zhāng de qīng xiàng
倾向.en: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
倾向.es: Me parece a mí que ella tiene una tendencia a exagerar.

倾向.zh: 汤姆公开自己的同性恋倾向。
倾向.pinyin: Tāng mǔ gōng kāi zì jǐ de tóng xìng liàn qīng xiàng
Chē chén rén qīng xiàng dú lì

节奏.pinyin: Zhè shì shū huǎn de dōng fāng jié zòu

告诫.pinyin: Tā gào jiè tā men bù yào chǎo nào
告诫.en: He admonished them for being noisy.
告诫.es: Él los reprendió por el ruido.

耐用.zh: 我需要耐用好几年的手机。
耐用.pinyin: Wǒ xū yào nài yòng hǎo jǐ nián de shǒu jī
耐用.en: I need a phone that can last for several years.

通货膨胀.zh: 随着通货膨胀的发展美元贬值了。
